mostWorthwhile.text: Powering the membrane pump was most worthwhile: the picture showed how ATP helps move particles toward the crowded side, not just that the pump fits the membrane.

surprise.text: The pump could move particles toward the more crowded side when powered by ATP. Its changing shape helped me picture the job.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and named goals gave reasons for the pairings, although I followed the ATP arrow for protein construction without knowing the detailed mechanism.
